exercise.instruction: Write an async function load() that fetches "data.json", awaits res.json(), and sets output.textContent to data.title. Call load() at the end. (The preview has no real data.json — we're testing the code structure, not the result.)
hints: Hint 1: async function load() { const res = await fetch("data.json"); ... }

quiz.question: What does res.json() do?
options: Reads and parses the response body as JSON

quiz.question: Does fetch reject on a 404 response?
options: No, only on network failures — check res.ok

quiz.question: How do you turn an object into a JSON string?
